name: pdk-jsondiff-etl
instr:
We diff the nightly catalog snapshots with jsondiff and send the diff to the stores, which patch their own copy. Since the exporter was replaced, products and their variants come out in a different order every night, so the diffs are full of moves and changes to records nobody touched. Two nights of the export are in /data/catalog/.

Please add a key option: `key="id"` for `jsondiff.diff`, `jsondiff.patch` and `JsonDiffer`, and `--key id` for `jdiff` (`python -m jsondiff.cli`), for diffing and with `-p`. Objects in a list are then matched by that field at any depth, in any order. A snapshot whose records only moved diffs to `{}`, and a diff carries nothing from unchanged records and, for a changed record, only its changed fields and what identifies it. This goes for the compact and the symmetric syntax.

Patching the older snapshot, its records in any order, must give the newer one, also with `marshal=True` on both calls and the diff written as JSON and read back in between. A symmetric diff must also unpatch the newer snapshot to the older one. All of this has to hold for any two exports like the samples. If a list has two records with the same id, `diff` raises `ValueError` and `jdiff` exits with status 1. Lists where no object has the field, and everything without `key`, must diff exactly as now, and the tests in /app/tests must keep passing.

There's no network here; the dependencies are installed.
